excerpt: We report new measurements of the parity-violating asymmetry A_PV in elastic scattering of 3 GeV electrons off hydrogen and 4He targets with <theta_lab>~6.0 degrees. title: Precision Measurements of the Nucleon Strange Form Factors at Q^2 ~0.1 GeV^2
